newsitem.title: UK: Debonair makes steady debut on EASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Debonair makes steady debut on EASDAQ.

text.p: Shares in airline owner Debonair Holdings Plc on Friday traded at around their issue price of 450p on their first day of dealings on the EASDAQ stock market, dealers said.
By 1402 GMT, Debonair shares were quoted at 450p and over 1.1 million shares had been traded.
Dealers said the stock had earlier come under selling pressure from mainly private client brokers but rallied after buying support emerged from institutional investors.
"The stock feels quite firm at these levels," said one dealer.
The airline, which flies six aircraft on eleven routes in Europe, has seen its passenger numbers grow from 3,000 in its first month of operation a year ago to over 50,000 in May 1997.

Debonair said before its flotation it planned to establish itself as a low fare, "home-based" airline in many European destinations and would take advantage of the deregulation process in Europe's air transport industry.
The airline made pre-tax losses of about 15 million stg in its first year of operation which included a 13 million stg provision for start up costs.
